name: Alt+C and Alt+V second press should close the viewport menu
body:
# Alt+C and Alt+V second press should close the viewport menu

Pressing Alt+C or Alt+V again while its viewport menu is open should close it (ToggleViewportMenu already toggles by name). Found by Dean in a live check; cause not yet known, to be reproduced in the running editor.

comments.text: Done 2026-11-19. Cause: EditorCommands.RunCommand closed every popup before the toggle ran, so the toggle always saw the menu closed and reopened it. A viewportMenu: command now skips that close. Checked live: open, close, open, close for both keys.
